summary: PLAN_ID=toolchain-workflow-repair; CLI requires --repository-root and --plan-dir, optional --out; validates exactly one slice-receipt.json for each W0-W6 under logs/tdd-adapter/<PLAN_ID>/<slice>; receipt must predicate=slice-ready, status=pass, failures=[], authorizes=[]; malformed, missing, or duplicate receipts fail; emits schema toolchain-workflow-repair.terminal-result.v2 with predicate=implementation-complete, status pass/fail, failures, authorizes=[], lifecycle_transition=none; writes JSON to --out and stdout; exit 0 on pass, 1 on failures
